Name: Riftworks addon - resources from chest anywhere
Author: Alex3108
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]A small addon that allows you to use resources not only from your inventory but also from location chests for construction and operations in the Riftworks mod. [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install Valley Bonds, Isekai Bonds, and Riftworks.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extract the[/color]


[code]ValleyBonds.Riftworks.ChestResources[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder into your Stardew Valley[/color]


[code]Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Do not place the ZIP file directly inside the[/color]


[code]Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Required:[/color]


[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.0 or later.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Valley Bonds.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Valley Bonds: Isekai Bonds.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Valley Bonds: Riftworks.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]This add-on does not work as a standalone mod. [/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to the Stardew Valley and SMAPI communities, Riftworks testers, and everyone who provided feedback on rooms, guests, balancing, and hospitality gameplay. [/color]

Manifest.Name: Riftworks: Chest Resources
Manifest.Description: Lets Valley Bonds: Riftworks pay normal material costs from Better Crafting-compatible storages.
